name: Uzkaya doroga (Narrow road)
justification: Statement is Russian-only, which makes it unusable in an English-language race despite the clean answer format.
solution_sketch: Process scooters front to back: b1 = a1-1 and b_i = max(a_i-i, b_{i-1}+1), since each scooter advances i metres unless it is blocked one metre behind its predecessor.
